conditional_required_blocks.note: Any promo/bill-credit/gift-card/referral mention requires 'Terms apply' + hyperlink to promo-terms page.

require_all: you agree to the offer terms
conditional_required_blocks.note: Any 'Apply Here/Now' CTA button requires the agreement hyperlink beneath it.
Approximate check only -- disclosure phrasing varies ('paid partner', 'I get a referral credit', etc). A miss here is common; treat this rule as low-recall, not proof of absence.

require_all: you can obtain important standardized information
conditional_required_blocks.note: Verbatim TX comparison disclaimer required when ad states a specific price/savings comparison vs another REP. Trigger detection here is crude keyword matching -- confirm applicability with Tier C before trusting a PASS.

require_all: is not the same entity as your electric delivery company
conditional_required_blocks.note: Verbatim IL PTC statement required on any priced/enrollment IL ad.
